senses.example: Ponte un jersey, que hace frío.
senses.exampleGloss: Put a jumper on, it is cold.

alternatives.reason: LatAm/borrowed form; not the Peninsular word.
Rioplatense form; understood in Spain but uncommon.
Often used in Spain for a cardigan; a related but different garment.

notes: Spelled jersey in Spanish, plural jerséis; the English word is the origin but the Spanish spelling is fixed.
